subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant thread status show sanitized active-tool labels, or remain generic while progress lives in loading messages, draft previews, and reactions?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable behavior depends on Slack UX and disclosure policy rather than a mechanical missing callback alone.

options.title: Gate through safe progress policy
options.body: Implement native per-tool status only after or alongside the Slack-safe visibility model so status labels are sanitized and consistent across progress surfaces.

options.title: Keep native status generic
options.body: Leave assistant thread status as generic typing/loading text and make draft/reaction progress the intended tool-progress surface.

options.title: Map tools directly now
options.body: Wire onToolStart straight to setSlackThreadStatus, accepting the risk of duplicated progress and future policy churn.

recommendation.title: Gate through safe progress policy
recommendation.body: Implement native per-tool status only after or alongside the Slack-safe visibility model so status labels are sanitized and consistent across progress surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Slack dispatch/thread lifecycle history and current-main ownership make this the best available routing candidate for the product-direction choice.
